description: List the workspace's labels as a tree: groups (isGroup true) carry their labels in `labels`, and ungrouped labels sit at the top level. Each item has labelId, name, description, color, parentId, source (`speak` for Speak label sets), usageCount and isActive. Use the labelIds of non-group labels with apply_label. Anyone in the workspace can read labels.

search.description: Case-insensitive name match; a group is listed when it or any of its labels match

name: list_labels

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
